oracles.receiver: Production flat z=-4 m unoccluded quad with strongly tilted smooth normals and zero metre bias. Shadows enabled versus disabled: old maximum error 18 sRGB codes; corrected implementation passes unchanged <=1-code tolerance.
oracles.near: Exact legacy equivalence when omitted, preserved count/far endpoint, monotonic geometric spacing, invalid inputs, single-cascade far cover, requested/resolved round trips and defensive clamps
oracles.precision: Conservative <1 cm clip-space f64-to-f32 narrowing envelope at 3e12 m origin and 12 km reach; this is not a universal contact/bias error bound
oracles.gpu: Legacy and explicit cover retain independent per-light occlusion, exact depth-cache versus forced-redraw equality and large-origin behavior; actual atlas allocation and finite far caster cover asserted unchanged
oracles.disabled: Existing disabled atlas path retained; optional distance does not enable shadows or add a pass/allocation

near_policy.configuration: shadows.first_cascade_distance_m = 25.0; optional/commented in graphics.toml, not enabled by default
near_policy.clamp: Finite requests to 1 m..resolved far cover; non-finite requests fall back to legacy with a note
near_policy.allocation: Same three-star/four-cascade 1024 px layers, 48 MiB under the existing 64 MiB cap
near_policy.limit: Precision redistribution, not analytic area-light penumbrae or resolved thin-leaf shadows

negative_evidence.first_draft: near-native-v1 and exploratory-captures.json: near cover alone did not eliminate trunk stripes; 0.02 m normal-bias captures are diagnostics, not a retained default or a proved global bias bound
negative_evidence.residency: The v2 after-legacy standing control differs in a few intermediate material-page residency counts despite drained streams. Do not treat its full-frame delta as shadow-only. The selected near standing and close pairs match residency histograms, survey/source metadata, plant counts/draws/uploads, anisotropy and map resolution. Histogram equality does not prove byte-identical resident page IDs/content.
negative_evidence.visual: Final frames retain thin-leaf aliasing, some trunk stripes, grid-like coarse shadows and unconvincing flat ground/shore. Numerical correction is not a claim that all visible stripes are solved.
